description: Lifecycle of US Hydropower Facilities: How data at every stage drives growth is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Debjani Singh, Thomas Ruggles (Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)). This product highlights data across all stages of a hydropower facility’s lifecycle. These data enable collaborative discussion on what is needed to enhance current facility performance, reduce operations and maintenance costs, streamline the permitting process, support new project development, and address environmental concerns with a determined focus on mitigation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
